tips.title: Reminders for a healthy pregnancy
tips.note: General information only. Always follow your midwife's advice.
items: Go to all your prenatal checkups, even when you feel well.
Take the iron and folic acid tablets from your health center.
Eat a variety of food, like malunggay and other vegetables, fish, eggs and beans, and drink clean water.
Rest well, and avoid smoking and alcohol.
Bring your card or booklet to every visit.
tips.dangerTitle: Get help right away if you have:
danger: A severe headache or blurred vision
Swelling of the face or hands
Your baby moving less than usual
Water breaking or strong pains before your due date

today.countedFromLmp: Counted from the first day of your last period.
tips: Go to every prenatal checkup, even when you feel well.
Take your iron and folic acid tablets every day.
Drink plenty of clean water through the day.
Eat small, frequent meals with vegetables like malunggay, fish, eggs and beans.
Rest when you can. Later in pregnancy, sleeping on your left side is best.
Walk or move gently every day, unless your midwife tells you otherwise.
Stay away from smoking, second-hand smoke and alcohol.
Ask the health center before taking any medicine or herbal remedy.
Keep your mother's booklet safe and bring it to every visit.
Get your tetanus vaccine on time. Ask the midwife when it's due.
Plan where you will give birth and how you will get there.
From the middle of pregnancy, notice your baby's movements every day.
